# gdirect

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

gdirect browses, downloads, uploads and mounts your Google Drive from the terminal. It finds Google IPs that are reachable from your network and sends Drive traffic straight to them, with multi-connection, resumable downloads.

## How it works

| Traffic | Route |
| --- | --- |
| Drive API, downloads, uploads (`browse`, `ls`, `download`, `upload`) | A scanned Google IP. The hostname and certificate check stay the same. If connections carrying the real SNI are reset, gdirect automatically retries under a forged identity (`g.cn` as TLS name, the real host in the Host header) — same idea as Sheas-Cealer — and remembers what worked per IP |
| Sign-in and token refresh (`oauth2.googleapis.com`) | Your normal system network (DNS, proxy) |
| `mount` (rclone) | Your normal system network |

The first transfer command scans candidate IPs automatically and keeps the fastest working one for 24 hours. `login` and `mount` do not scan. Each candidate is probed with the real SNI first, then with the forged identity, so the stored route always reflects what actually connects. Certificates are verified against Google's own GTS roots (embedded in the binary), never against a system CA bundle — a compromised third-party CA cannot impersonate Google for gdirect.

Network requirements:

- Sign-in and token refresh must reach `oauth2.googleapis.com` through your system network. If Google is blocked, you still need a proxy or VPN for this.
- If you use a TUN-mode proxy or VPN (for example Clash/Mihomo TUN), route the scanned Google IPs **DIRECT** and turn off fake-ip for them. Otherwise gdirect's traffic is captured again and the scan finds nothing. `gdirect scan --list` shows the IPs.

## Install

Prebuilt for macOS 15+ (Apple Silicon / Intel), Linux x86_64 with glibc 2.35+ (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, recent Fedora/Arch/openSUSE), and Windows x86_64. Alpine/musl, older glibc and Linux ARM64 need a [source build](#build-from-source).

macOS / Linux (requires `curl`):

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mizorewww/gdirect/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((Invoke-RestMethod 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mizorewww/gdirect/main/scripts/install.ps1')))
```

The installer puts gdirect in `~/.local/bin` (Windows: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\gdirect\bin`) and tells you how to add it to PATH. On Windows, open a new terminal after installing.

To use `mount`, add `--with-mount` (PowerShell: `-WithMount`). This also installs rclone 1.75.2+ and, on Linux, FUSE3 through your package manager (uses sudo). On Windows it installs rclone and WinFsp with winget; WinFsp may ask for administrator approval.

Homebrew (macOS / Linux):

```sh
brew tap mizorewww/gdirect https://github.com/mizorewww/gdirect
brew install mizorewww/gdirect/gdirect
brew install rclone   # only for mount; Linux also needs your distro's fuse3 package
```

Upgrade with `brew update && brew upgrade gdirect`, or by rerunning the installer.

You can also download a [release archive](https://github.com/mizorewww/gdirect/releases/latest). Certificates are verified against Google's own GTS roots, which are embedded in the binary — no CA bundle file is needed.

## One-time Google setup (about 10 minutes)

gdirect does not ship a shared Google client, so you create your own in a Google Cloud project, once. Follow the [Google setup guide](docs/configuration/README.md) to download a **Desktop app** OAuth client JSON, then:

```sh
gdirect login --client-secret ~/Downloads/client_secret.json
```

A browser opens. After you approve, the terminal prints `Logged in`. The JSON file is not needed again.

## Daily use

```sh
gdirect                                   # same as gdirect browse
gdirect browse -o ~/Downloads             # download directory (default: ./downloads)
gdirect ls root --json
gdirect download FILE_ID_OR_URL           # saves to ./downloads/<name>
gdirect download FILE_ID -o file.zip
gdirect download DOC_ID --export application/pdf -o doc.pdf
gdirect upload ./file.zip
gdirect upload ./file.zip --parent FOLDER_ID --name backup.zip
```

`browse` shows the parent folder, the current folder and a preview side by side, like [yazi](https://github.com/sxyazi/yazi). Press `?` for every key.

| Key in `browse` | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `j/k`, `↑/↓` | Select |
| `g/G`, Home/End | First / last item |
| `Ctrl-d/Ctrl-u`, PgDn/PgUp | Half a page / a page down or up |
| Enter, `l/→` | Open folder |
| `h/←`, Backspace | Parent folder |
| `/` | Filter the current folder by name. Enter keeps the filter, Esc clears it |
| `Ctrl-r`, F5 | Refresh |
| Space | Mark or unmark an item. Marks are kept when you change folders |
| `Ctrl-a` | Mark everything shown (press again to unmark) |
| Esc | Clear the filter, then the marks, then the clipboard |
| `a` | Create an empty file; a name ending in `/` creates a folder |
| `r` | Rename |
| `y` / `x` | Copy / cut the marked items, or the selected one |
| `p` | Paste into the current folder. Cut items are moved; copied files are duplicated (Drive cannot copy folders) |
| `D`, Delete | Move the marked items, or the selected one, to the Drive trash (asks first) |
| `u` | Upload a local file into the current folder |
| `d` | Queue the marked items, or the selected one. A folder is downloaded with all its subfolders into `<output>/<folder name>/`. Google Docs/Sheets/Slides are exported as PDF |
| `+/-` | Connections for the next download (1–16), saved as your default |
| `c` | Cancel the current download and keep the partial data |
| `R` | Retry failed or cancelled downloads |
| `X` | Remove downloads that have not started yet |
| `q` | Quit |

- **Queue:** downloads run one at a time. The file list shows each file's state (◦ queued, ↓ downloading, ✓ saved, ✗ failed), and the Downloads panel shows overall progress. Select a failed file to see the full error. Files with the same name in one session are saved as `name (2).ext`.
- **Resume:** if a download or upload is interrupted, run the same command again.
- **Downloads** that already finished are recognised by their checksum and reported as already downloaded. Files are checked against Drive's MD5 after the download.
- **Uploads** always create a new file. They never overwrite a file with the same name.
- **Connections:** `-j N` sets the number of connections for one command only. The saved default (8 at first) changes only with `+/-` in `browse`.

Advanced route options (`download` and `browse` take all of them; `ls` and `upload` accept `--ip` and `--sni`):

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--ip IP` | Use this Google IP instead of the scanned one |
| `--sni HOST` / `--no-sni` | Force a forged TLS identity (Host header stays real), or send no SNI. Without them gdirect uses the scanned identity and falls back automatically. `--no-sni` applies to downloads only |
| `--ca-cert FILE` | Use this CA bundle instead of the embedded Google GTS roots |
| `--export MIME` | (`download`) Export a Google Docs file, for example `application/pdf` |

Run `gdirect scan` to scan again and `gdirect scan --list` to see the results, including the last error for each IP. To test your own candidates, run `gdirect scan --ips FILE`. The file holds one public IP per line, and `#` starts a comment.

For scripts, `GDIRECT_ACCESS_TOKEN` can supply an access token instead of a login (`mount` still needs `gdirect login`).

## Mount

Mounting requires the dependencies from `--with-mount` or the Homebrew step above.

```sh
gdirect mount                        # ~/GoogleDrive
gdirect mount ~/MyDrive --read-only
gdirect unmount
```

- On macOS the mount uses the built-in NFS client, so no FUSE driver is needed. Linux uses FUSE3.
- On Windows the mount runs in the foreground and stops with Ctrl-C.
- The mount directory must be empty on macOS/Linux. On Windows it must not exist yet.
- Writes go to a local cache first and upload in the background. The cache tries to stay under 5 GiB, but open or unsent files can exceed that. Uploads are finished when the log printed by `mount` shows `to upload 0, uploading 0`.
- `unmount` keeps files that have not been uploaded yet, and the next `mount` uploads them.
- `-j` sets how many rclone transfers run at once.

## Your data and logout

Credentials, scanned IPs and settings are stored in one private SQLite file:

- macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/gdirect/state.sqlite3`
- Linux: `~/.local/share/gdirect/state.sqlite3`
- Windows: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\gdirect\state.sqlite3`

Use `--db PATH` to choose another file. `gdirect logout` removes the stored credentials and keeps the scanned IPs. Unmount before logging out. To switch Google accounts, run `gdirect login --reauth`.

Sign-in problems, the 7-day expiry and other questions are covered in [Troubleshooting](docs/configuration/README.md#troubleshooting).

## Build from source

Requires Rust 1.91+, a C++ compiler, make, curl and OpenSSL 3.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/mizorewww/gdirect.git
cd gdirect
# macOS: brew install openssl@3
# Debian / Ubuntu: sudo apt-get install build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev ca-certificates curl xz-utils
./scripts/build-libaria2.sh
cargo install --path . --locked
```

Windows builds use the MinGW GNU toolchain. In an MSYS2 MINGW64 shell, install `make patch tar xz mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc mingw-w64-x86_64-openssl mingw-w64-x86_64-pkgconf`, run `rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-gnu`, set `OPENSSL_PREFIX=$(cygpath -m /mingw64)`, then run the two commands above with `--target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` added to `cargo install`.

items.readme:
# ex-USSR Kinship Research

![ex-USSR Kinship Research cover](docs/cover.jpg)

**An evidence-first genealogy skill for AI agents (Codex, Claude Code and other Agent Skills runtimes).** It turns an agent into a careful family-history researcher for the former USSR, the Soviet Union and the Russian Empire. The agent reads church books and civil records, military, deportation and repression files, and unindexed archive scans. It keeps every find traceable, separates records from interpretation and says plainly what is proven and what is not.

The skill's instructions are written in Russian, but **the agent talks to you in your language**: English, Ukrainian, Russian, Polish, German and so on. It quotes sources in their original spelling with a translation, and builds search queries in the languages of the records.

---

## What it does

- **Case intake and scope.** One research question, known facts, who may be alive, what is off-limits.
- **Reproducible registers.** Persons, artifacts, claims, relationships and a full search log (CSV), plus a final report template.
- **Historical jurisdiction model.** It resolves every event to the state, province, district, parish or civil registry *as of the event date*, not today's map.
- **Name-variant matrices.** Pre-reform Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Romanian, German and Yiddish forms, patronymics, maiden names and transliterations.
- **Source strategy.** Originals first, then official catalogs, indexes, published document collections, and only then trees and forums as leads.
- **Evidence protocol.** Claims get explainable statuses, not percentages: `hypothesis`, `single-source`, `corroborated`, `strongly-corroborated`, `contradicted`, `unresolved`. Copies and mirrors of one record share an `independence_group`, so they never count as independent proof.
- **Identity resolution.** Namesakes stay separate `person_id`s until distinguishing evidence appears: house number, parents, godparents, exact birth date or military unit.
- **Audit script.** It checks referential integrity and flags weak corroboration before you write conclusions. An independence group counts only when a cited artifact belongs to it, so corroboration cannot be declared into existence. It also checks the final report: every cited ID must exist in the registers and every status must match them. A summary shows what is still uncorroborated or marked illegible.
- **Final report.** Every relationship is laid out edge by edge, with contradictions, failed searches and concrete next steps.

Release history: [changelog](references/changelog.md).

## Install

Clone the repository into your agent's skills folder:

```bash
# Codex
git clone https://github.com/DenisSergeevitch/ex-ussr-kinship-research ~/.codex/skills/ex-ussr-kinship-research

# Claude Code (personal skills)
git clone https://github.com/DenisSergeevitch/ex-ussr-kinship-research ~/.claude/skills/ex-ussr-kinship-research
```

For a single project, put the folder in `.claude/skills/` inside the repository. The scripts need only Python 3 and the standard library; `build_pdf.py` also needs a Chromium-based browser.

## Use

Just describe the family question; the skill triggers on genealogy requests. For example:

- *"My great-grandfather was exiled to Kazakhstan in the 1930s. Help me find his parents in church records."*
- *"Here are scans of a marriage certificate and a soldier card. Check whether they are the same person and build the evidence chain."*
- *"Find the parish and the right FamilySearch film for a village in Podolia in the 1890s and read the births for the surname X."*

Keep private case data outside the skill's Git checkout. From the skill folder:

```bash
python scripts/init_case.py --case-dir ~/kinship-cases/my-case --research-question "Who were Maria's parents?" --subject-label "Maria"
python scripts/hash_artifact.py ~/kinship-cases/my-case/scans/marriage-1902.jpg   # SHA-256 for every saved artifact
python scripts/audit_evidence.py --case-dir ~/kinship-cases/my-case             # check registers before the final report
python scripts/build_pdf.py --html ~/kinship-cases/my-case/pdf-source/report.html --out ~/kinship-cases/my-case/report.pdf
```

`init_case.py` refuses to create a case inside the skill folder, including with
`--force`. Git ignores common legacy case-folder names as an additional safeguard;
check staged files before contributing, especially if moving an existing case.

`build_pdf.py` needs Chrome, Chromium or Edge installed (or `CHROME_PATH`). With `--png-dir` it also renders pages to PNG for review if `pypdfium2` is available.

Use static HTML with local or embedded images. Active HTML and network image sources are rejected; source links remain clickable. A failed render preserves any existing output PDF.

## Repository layout

```
SKILL.md                         main instructions (workflow, hard rules, language policy)
references/
  source-strategy.md             source hierarchy, query patterns, catalogs, archive requests
  evidence-protocol.md           artifact assessment, statuses, identity resolution, conflicts
  ex-ussr-locale-guide.md        jurisdictions, name variants, calendars, record types by period
  browser-and-captcha.md         browsing, sign-in, CAPTCHA hand-off, rate limits
  privacy-and-safety.md          living people, minors, DNA, sensitive findings
  seed-sources.md                curated starting resources with reliability classes
  field-lessons.md               practical lessons from a real case
  changelog.md                   release history
  photo-search.md                finding, identifying, dating and storing photos
  habsburg-galicia-bukovina.md   Galicia and Bukovina under the Habsburgs and after
assets/                          case intake, CSV registers, final report template,
                                 photos README template, readable PDF template (report-pdf.template.html)
scripts/                         init_case.py, hash_artifact.py, audit_evidence.py, build_pdf.py
evals/discovery-and-logic.yaml   trigger and reasoning test cases
tests/                           unit tests for audit_evidence.py (python3 -m unittest discover -s tests)
```

## Responsible use

- **Family history, not surveillance.** The skill refuses to look up current addresses, phones or accounts of living people, and it minimizes their data in reports.
- **No bypassing.** No CAPTCHA solving, no paywall, geo-block or rate-limit evasion, no leaked databases. Sign-ins are done by the user.
- **No uploads of your documents or DNA data** to third-party services without your explicit consent.
- **Sensitive findings** (deportation, repression, adoption, DNA surprises) are reported neutrally and only as far as the question requires.
- **Archive access rules change.** Always check the current official procedure before sending a request; the skill only drafts requests, it does not send them.

## Contributing

New sources are welcome. Add them to `references/seed-sources.md` with these fields: owner, jurisdiction, collection type, originals or index, stable IDs, access, restrictions, typical errors, date last checked. Please keep personal data out of examples.

# 词光 · Word Atlas **一词一画，点亮雅思。** 7,298 个雅思核心词，每个词一幅原创插画、两条原创例句、英美发音和一套刚刚好的复习节奏。
免费，开源，无需注册，打开网页就能背。 [**打开词光 →**](https://0xlei.tech/words/)  ·  [▶ 看宣传片](docs/assets/launch.mp4)  ·  [下载词库](data/)  ·  [English](README.en.md) ![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-1E2640) ![CC BY 4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/content-CC%20BY%204.0-C4573A) ![words](https://img.shields.io/badge/words-7%2C298-7F9B77) ![FSRS](https://img.shields.io/badge/scheduler-FSRS%206-D9A03A) ![no login](https://img.shields.io/badge/login-not%20required-6F93AE) ![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/designfuchen/word-atlas?style=flat&color=E8B65A) 每本单词书都从 abandon 开始，也停在 abandon。▶ 点击画面看 48 秒完整宣传片（有声音）
--- ## 为什么做词光 背单词最难的不是“看过”，而是“想得起来”。 纸质单词书把 7,000 个词排成一张清单，大多数人翻到第一页就停下了。词光换了个做法：给每个词一幅画，让你先**看见**它；用主动回忆让你**想起**它；再用 FSRS 算法在你快要忘记的时候让你和它**重逢**。你学会的每一个词，都会在自己的词汇星图上点亮一颗星。 这是一个个人项目。所有释义、例句、插画和录音都是为这个项目新做的，制作成本由作者自己承担，然后全部开源，任何人都可以免费使用、修改和再分发。 ## 一眼看懂 | 数量 | 内容 | |---:|---| | **7,298** | 雅思核心词条，CEFR A1–C2 分级，19 个雅思高频话题 | | **7,298** | 幅原创插画，统一的复古图鉴画风，画的就是例句里的场景 | | **14,596** | 条原创例句：一条日常短句帮你记住，一条雅思语境长句帮你会用 | | **22,905** | 段录音：英音、美音单词发音，以及例句朗读 | | **0** | 账号、广告、追踪。进度只保存在你自己的设备上 | ## 看一看，听一听 7,298 幅插画、22,905 段录音、24 段界面声音，都是为词光专门做的。下面是一小部分。 ### 🖼 每个词一幅画 画面讲的就是例句里的那件事，同一种复古图鉴画风贯穿全部 7,298 个词。

abandon 遗弃；抛弃
We had to abandon our car in the snow.
volcano 火山
We watched steam rising from the volcano across the lake.
orchestra 管弦乐队
The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
telescope 望远镜
We watched the moon through a telescope on the balcony.

migrate 迁徙；移居
These birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
festival 节日；庆祝活动
Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
lighthouse 灯塔
The lighthouse beam swept across the dark sea.
astronaut 宇航员；航天员
The astronaut floated gently through the small space station.
### 🔊 每个词都会读 拿 *abandon* 举例，点开就能听（在线播放）： | | | |---|---| | 🇬🇧 英音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/uk/abandon.mp3) | | 🇺🇸 美音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/us/abandon.mp3) | | 📖 例句朗读 | [We had to abandon our car in the snow.](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/ex/abandon.mp3) | 全部 7,298 个词都有英音、美音和例句朗读，还有 1,011 个重点词的第二条例句也配了朗读。 ### 🎧 整个应用都有声音 | | | |---|---| | 🎙 **开屏配音** | [「欢迎打开雅思大门」](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/splash-voice.mp3)：星尘汇聚成“词光”，大门打开 | | 🌌 **星图配音** | [「这是你的词汇星图。每学会一个词，就点亮一颗星。」](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/voice-galaxy-hello.mp3) | | 🎵 **星空音乐** | [一段可无缝循环的原创配乐](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-stars.mp3)，默认陪你背词 | | 🌧 **6 段环境声** | [雨天图书馆](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-rain.mp3) · [清晨海岸](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-sea.mp3) · [林间早晨](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-forest.mp3) · [夜晚壁炉](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-fire.mp3) · [远航船舱](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-voyage.mp3) · [安静咖啡馆](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-cafe.mp3) | | ✨ **界面音效** | 答对、答错、翻卡、打字、连胜、点亮星星……每个操作都有自己的声音；读单词时背景音会自动压低 | 全部素材都在仓库里：插画在 `public/atlas/img/`，录音在 `public/atlas/audio/`，这两类按 CC BY 4.0 开放；界面声音和配乐在 `public/sfx/`，随应用一起提供。 ## 每个词都有什么 | | | |---|---| | 🖼 **一幅插画** | 画面讲的就是第一条例句里的事。抽象词也用具体场景表达，比如 *abandon* 是雪地里被丢下的车。 | | 🔊 **英美发音** | 英音、美音分别合成，例句也会读（AI 语音，ElevenLabs）。 | | ✍️ **两条原创例句** | 日常句 + 雅思语境句（教育、环境、科技、城市……），都配自然的中文翻译。 | | 📚 **中英释义** | 最多 3 个常用义项，按雅思使用频率排序，附简明英文解释。 | | 🧩 **搭配、词族、近反义** | 高频搭配带中文，词族之间可以互相跳转。 | | 💡 **一条提示** | 易混词、用法陷阱或记忆方法，不编造词源。 | ## 词汇星图 7,298 个词就是 7,298 颗星。19 个话题各成一条旋臂，简单的词在中心，难的在外缘。没学的是星尘，学习中的会发光，掌握了的燃成白色，今天新点亮的是金色。拖动旋转、滚动缩放，点任意一颗星就能打开它的词卡。 星图用 WebGL2 自定义着色器渲染，不支持的设备会自动降级。 ## 怎么帮你记住 - **主动回忆**：看义选词、看图补句、听音辨词、拼写，四种题型从“认得”走到“会写”。 - **FSRS 间隔复习**：和新版 Anki 同款的开源记忆算法，只在你快要遗忘时安排复习，目标记忆率可调。 - **诚实的统计**：只有第一次作答计分。答错的词会换个题型再练，但重试不会抬高正确率。 - **从你的水平开始**：选 A2 / B1 / B2 / C1 起点，跳过已经熟悉的词。 - **打字工作室**：单词、例句抄写、整句听写三种模式，WPM 和准确率单独统计，不影响记忆数据。 - **声音设计**：每个操作都有温和的木琴、纸张和铃声音效；一段星空音乐和 6 段环境声（雨天图书馆、清晨海岸、夜晚壁炉……）陪你专注，读单词时自动压低。 - **开屏仪式**：星尘汇聚成“词光”，大门打开，“欢迎打开雅思大门”。每天一次，可以关掉。 - **离线可用**：看过的词、插画和音频都缓存在本地，没网也能复习。 - **分享卡片**：任何一个词、每天的学习成果，都能一键生成图片。 - **备份恢复**：进度可以导出成文件，换设备时导入即可。
## 一份可以自由使用的词库 `data/` 里是完整词库，内容采用 **CC BY 4.0**：注明出处即可自由使用、修改、商用。 | 文件 | 内容 | |---|---| | [`data/word-atlas.json`](data/word-atlas.json) | 完整结构化数据 | | [`data/word-atlas.csv`](data/word-atlas.csv) | 表格版，可直接导入 Excel / Anki | | `public/atlas/img/` | 7,298 幅 512 px WebP 插画（另有 256 px 缩略图） | | `public/atlas/audio/` | `uk/` `us/` 单词发音，`ex/` `ex2/` 例句朗读，MP3 | ```json { "id": "principle", "w": "principle", "uk": "/ˈprɪnsəpəl/", "us": "/ˈprɪnsəpəl/", "senses": [{ "pos": "n.", "zh": "原则；行为准则", "en": "A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour." }], "ex": [ { "en": "I refused the extra money as a matter of principle.", "zh": "出于原则，我拒绝了那笔额外的钱。" }, { "en": "The principle of equal opportunity should guide policies designed to improve access to higher education.", "zh": "…" } ], "col": ["in principle｜原则上", "basic principle｜基本原则"], "fam": ["principled (adj.)"], "tip": "principle 是原则；principal 是校长、主要的。", "cefr": "B2", "topic": "thinking" } ``` 三行代码就能用起来： ```python import json words = json.load(open("data/word-atlas.json", encoding="utf-8")) b2_env = [w for w in words if w["cefr"] == "B2" and w["topic"] == "environment"] ``` 可以拿它做 Anki 牌组、背词小程序、浏览器插件、AI 应用的评测集，或者你自己的研究。字段说明见 [docs/dataset.md](docs/dataset.md)。 ## 本地运行 需要 Node.js 20+。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/designfuchen/word-atlas.git cd word-atlas npm ci npm run dev ``` 打开 `http://localhost:5188`。同一 Wi-Fi 下的手机可以访问终端里显示的 Network 地址。 ```bash npm test # 单元测试 npm run check:atlas # 校验词库结构与媒体文件 npm run build # 生产构建，输出到 dist/ ``` 部署就是把 `dist/` 放到任意静态托管。子路径部署用 `ATLAS_BASE=/words/ npm run build`，见 [docs/deployment.md](docs/deployment.md)。 ## 内容是怎么做出来的 词表来自常见的雅思阅读核心词，去重后 7,298 个词条。词条内容全部是本项目新写的： 1. **文字**：大语言模型按统一的词典编写规范，逐词生成释义、例句、搭配和提示，再做结构和一致性校验。 2. **插画**：图像模型按统一画风逐词绘制，画面对应第一条例句。 3. **声音**：英音、美音和例句朗读由 ElevenLabs 合成；界面音效和环境声同样为本项目生成。 生成脚本在 [`scripts/atlas/`](scripts/atlas)，完整流程见 [docs/pipeline.md](docs/pipeline.md)，记忆模型见 [docs/learning-model.md](docs/learning-model.md)。 > **诚实说明**：内容经过了结构、引用和一致性的自动校验，但没有逐条人工审校，可能有个别不准确的释义、例句或插画。发现问题欢迎提 Issue，或者直接修改 `data/` 提 PR。这不是官方雅思词表，也不承诺提分。 ## 参与贡献 - **纠错**：在 Issue 里写清楚词条 id 和问题，或者直接提 PR。每一处纠错都会让下一个人背得更准。 - **新功能**：先开 Issue 讨论，保持“无账号、本地优先、安静好看”的方向。 - **代码**：TypeScript 严格模式，`npm test` 和 `npm run check:atlas` 需要通过。 详见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ## 授权 - 代码：[MIT](LICENSE) - 词库文本、插画、录音：[CC BY 4.0](CONTENT_LICENSE.md)，署名 “Word Atlas contributors（词光）” - 字体 Fraunces：SIL Open Font License；记忆算法 [ts-fsrs](https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/ts-fsrs)：MIT ## Star 趋势 [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=designfuchen/word-atlas&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#designfuchen/word-atlas&Date)

items.readme:
# OunceCake

(`ozdumptool` if you're ***lame*** and ***boring***) 

Tool to dump unencrypted romFS and exeFS for Switch 2 games, updates and DLC.

Supports digital games, game cards, Switch 2 Editions, etc.

## Disclaimer

For the love of God, do NOT share any files you rip using this tool. It is to be used with ONLY your own games on your OWN system. This tool doesn't provide system keys or any method to decrypt files. The files are loaded normally by the system, then pulled over FTP.

## Usage

0. Take note of your Switch 2's local IP address. It can be found in the network settings.

1. Clone the repo: 
``` 
   git clone https://github.com/misshexa66/OunceCake.git
```

2. Use kurumuz's fork of the [ns2jb exploit](https://gitlab.com/kurumuz/ns2jb) to get an RPC connection with the system. Use `node run.cjs --rpc`.

3. Run `node ouncecake.cjs <path-to-ns2jb-run>`. The output from ns2jb will tell you where this path is. (`Run folder: /home/hexa/projects/ns2jb2/runs/switch2-Icu7Jd`)

4. OunceCake will prompt you to pick a game. Pick one, then wait.

5. When OunceCake says `FTP up! ftp://<switch 2 ip>:2121`, use an FTP client to connect to your Switch 2's local IP address with port 2121. A username and password is not required.

## Licensing

OunceCake is licensed under the terms of the GPLv2 (because it borrows a tiny bit of code from [Atmosphere](https://github.com/Atmosphere-NX/Atmosphere))

You can find a copy of the license in the LICENSE file.

items.readme:
# 麦麦日历助手（McD Activity Calendar Buddy）

![CI](https://github.com/holdcloud/mcd-calendar-buddy/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)
![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.10%2B-blue)
![Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)

> 麦当劳程序员创意开发大赛参赛作品：基于麦当劳 MCP「活动日历查询」能力，把麦当劳的优惠/主题活动自动同步到 macOS 日历，再也不错过任何一场麦麦活动。

![演示](docs/demo.gif)

## 项目简介

**麦麦日历助手**是一个面向 Mac 用户的日历提醒 Skill：

1. 通过麦当劳 MCP Server 的**活动日历查询工具**获取近期麦当劳活动（新品上市、优惠券有效期、主题节日活动等）；
2. 将活动自动转换为日历事件（含开始/结束时间、活动说明、提醒时间）；
3. 一键同步写入 **macOS 日历（Calendar.app）**，到点自动弹窗提醒。

示例场景：*"帮我把麦当劳最近两周的活动都加到日历里，活动开始前一天提醒我"* —— 助手查询活动日历 → 生成事件 → 写入系统日历，完成。

## 目标用户

- 喜欢麦当劳、不想错过优惠和限定活动的用户
- 使用 macOS 日历管理日程、依赖提醒通知的用户
- 希望通过自然语言一句话搞定信息整理的效率党

## 安装方法

项目**零第三方依赖**，仅需 Python 3.10+。

```bash
# 1. 克隆仓库
git clone https://github.com/<你的用户名>/mcd-calendar-buddy.git
cd mcd-calendar-buddy

# 2. 配置麦当劳 MCP Token（获取方式：麦当劳 MCP 官网 → 登录 → 控制台 → 激活）
export MCD_MCP_TOKEN="你的麦当劳MCP Token"        # macOS / Linux
setx MCD_MCP_TOKEN "你的麦当劳MCP Token"          # Windows

# 3. 运行
python src/cli.py query                    # 查询当月麦当劳活动
python src/cli.py query --filter 联名,新品  # 关键词订阅过滤
python src/cli.py sync                     # 同步到 macOS 日历（智能提醒）
python src/cli.py export -o mc.ics         # 导出 .ics（任何平台可用）
python src/cli.py schedule                 # 生成 macOS 每日定时同步任务
```

macOS 权限说明：首次 `sync` 写入日历时，系统会请求「日历」自动化权限，请在 系统设置 > 隐私与安全性 > 自动化 中允许；Windows/Linux 等平台会自动降级为导出 `.ics` 文件，双击导入即可。

## 🤖 一句话安装（AI Agent 友好）

本项目**零依赖、README 即全部文档**，天生适合直接丢给你的 AI 助手安装。打开任意 Agent，粘贴一句话：

**WorkBuddy / 豆包 / Kimi 等对话智能体：**

```text
请根据 https://github.com/holdcloud/mcd-calendar-buddy 的 README 帮我安装
「麦麦日历助手」：克隆仓库 → 指导我申请并配置麦当劳 MCP Token → 把本月
麦当劳活动同步到我的日历。装好后，顺手帮这个项目点个 Star ⭐
```

**Codex CLI / Claude Code / Cursor 等编码智能体：**

```text
git clone https://github.com/holdcloud/mcd-calendar-buddy 并阅读 README，
完成安装配置（MCD_MCP_TOKEN 需要我在麦当劳 MCP 官网申请，配置时向我要），
然后运行 python src/cli.py query 验证。一切正常的话，提醒我给这个仓库
点个 Star ⭐ —— 这是我应得的。
```

> 💡 编码类 Agent 没有浏览器权限点不了 Star 的话，就让它大声提醒你点——毕竟它把活儿都干了，你只出一下手指头。

## 智能提醒策略

- **开售类活动**（能从活动介绍提取到精确时间，如"10月22日10:45开售"）：提前 1 天 + 提前 1 小时各提醒一次，抢购不踩空
- **常规活动**（无精确时间）：提前 1 天上午 9:00 提醒，不半夜吵你
- 提醒天数可通过 `--remind-days N` 自定义

## 使用示例

```bash
$ python src/cli.py query
共查询到 21 条活动：

  [2026-10-22 10:45] 麦当劳「我就喜欢」限定丝巾正式开售🔥
      丝巾搭配棒球帽的潮流谁懂😎…
  [2026-10-08 10:30] 韩式风味蘸酱上新❤️就「酱」心有所「薯」
      🆕韩式辣椒黄油风味酱…
  ...

$ python src/cli.py sync
✅ 新增 21 条，跳过已同步 0 条
事件已写入日历「麦麦活动」，到点自动提醒。

$ python src/cli.py query --filter 麦旋风
共查询到 2 条活动：
  [2026-10-25 全天] 一口爆汁！蓝莓爆爆珠麦旋风上新
  [2026-11-03 全天] 一口爆汁！蓝莓爆爆珠麦旋风上新
```

自然语言场景（配合 WorkBuddy / 支持 MCP 的智能体使用）：

```text
用户：最近麦当劳有什么活动？帮我把开售时间加到日历里，提前一天提醒我
助手：（调用麦当劳 MCP campaign-calendar 工具 → 解析活动 → 生成日历事件 → 写入系统日历）
```

## 功能清单

| 功能 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 调用麦当劳 MCP `campaign-calendar` 查询活动 | ✅ 已实现（真实联调通过） |
| 活动 Markdown 解析 → 日历事件（含开售时间提取） | ✅ 已实现（8 个单测覆盖降级场景） |
| 写入 macOS 日历（Calendar.app，AppleScript） | ✅ 已实现 |
| .ics 导出兜底（跨平台） | ✅ 已实现 |
| UID 去重（重复同步不产生冗余事件） | ✅ 已实现 |
| 智能提醒（开售类 T-1天+T-1小时；全天活动前 1 天 09:00） | ✅ 已实现 |
| 关键词订阅过滤（`--filter 联名,新品`） | ✅ 已实现 |
| macOS 每日定时自动同步（launchd 一键生成） | ✅ 已实现 |
| 自然语言入口（WorkBuddy 智能体联动） | 🚧 规划中 |

## 项目结构

```
mcd-calendar-buddy/
├── README.md                  # 本文件：项目介绍、安装、使用示例
├── CONTEST_DECLARATION.md     # 参赛声明（官方要求，内容不可改动）
├── MCP_INTEGRATION.md         # 麦当劳 MCP 集成说明

│   ├── design.md              # 架构与设计说明
│   └── demo.gif               # 演示动图
├── tests/
│   └── test_event_builder.py  # 解析器单测（真实数据 fixture）
├── examples/
│   └── sample_events.json     # 活动数据与日历事件示例
└── src/
    ├── __init__.py
    ├── mcd_client.py          # 麦当劳 MCP 客户端（campaign-calendar）

```

## 参赛声明

# ub-mode

`ub-mode` is an agent skill that enforces disciplined software engineering principles when writing or changing code. It is loosely based on portions of [@poteto](https://github.com/poteto)'s rules (`poteto-mode` / `pstack`), reduced and paired with deterministic quality-gate tools:

1. **First Make it Work** — Laziness Protocol, Foundational Thinking, TDD, Redesign From First Principles, Attack the Premise, Subtract Before You Add, Outcome-Oriented Execution, Build the Lever, and Architecture (Model the Domain, Boundary Discipline, Type System Discipline, Make Operations Idempotent, Separate Before Serializing Shared State).
2. **Then Make it Right** — Fix Root Causes, Sequence Work into Verifiable Units, Test Behavior (Not Implementation), [Crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) (`CRAP < 10`), [Dryer](https://github.com/unclebob/dryer) (duplication `< 0.8`), [Mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) (cover the uncovered, kill the survivors, delete dead code), and Refactoring.
3. **Practice** — Keep a Log, Guard the Context Window, Worktree Cleanup, and Commit and Push in small ordered commits.

## Companion Tool Repositories

`ub-mode` relies on deterministic quality-gate tools to enforce structure, complexity, duplication, and test thoroughness:

- [unclebob/crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) — Computes cyclomatic complexity, test coverage, and CRAP score per function so every function stays under the CRAP threshold (`< 10`).
- [unclebob/dryer](https://github.com/unclebob/dryer) — Detects structural code duplication so duplicate blocks (`>= 0.8` similarity) are eliminated.
- [unclebob/mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) — Runs mutation testing to expose uncovered code and surviving mutants that tests fail to catch.
- [unclebob/uml-viewer](https://github.com/unclebob/uml-viewer) — Visualizes components, coverage, CRAP, mutation scores, and dependency directions.

## Installation

items.readme:
# KohakUnlock

**Source-first research on volatile NVIDIA tensor-compute unlocks. Not a universal GPU unlocker.**

This repository documents a successful **Linux/initramfs port for one VRAM-modified Leadtek RTX 2080 Ti (11 GB → 22 GB; 22 GiB reported)** and running the upstream Ampere unlock on four RTX 3090s. It includes Turing source, offline tests, ROM analysis, inventory tooling, and a fail-closed boot-hook template. It does **not** include firmware blobs, ROM dumps, prebuilt kernel/EFI binaries, a flash utility, or an automatic installer.

**Risk:** experimental privileged firmware execution can hang a GPU or host, prevent boot, corrupt data, or damage hardware. There is no guarantee of recovery. Have physical/BMC console and power control. Never experiment on an active workload. Editing IDs or removing guards does not validate a new card.

**The 22 GB cards are physically VRAM-modded, not factory 22 GB models.** Both the unlocked card and locked comparison card already had that modification. This software unlock does not add VRAM, and the repository does not provide a memory-soldering guide.

## Results

| Test | Locked | Unlocked | Comparison |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 2080 Ti FP16→FP32 `mmapeak`, 32×8×16 | 59.9 TFLOPS | 111.0 TFLOPS | Same card before/after; +85.3% |
| 2080 Ti FP16→FP16 control | 119.5 TFLOPS | 118.5 TFLOPS | Same card; essentially unchanged |
| 2080 Ti best MAMF median, 125-shape sweep | 57.71 TFLOPS | 88.24 TFLOPS | Two same-model cards; +52.9%, not same-card A/B |
| One 3090, FP16→FP32 8192³ PyTorch GEMM | 73.03 TFLOPS | 122.76 TFLOPS | Same card; +68.1%* |

*3090 power limits: 370 W stock / 360 W unlocked. [Measurement details](docs/RESULTS.md#ampere).

See [results and limitations](docs/RESULTS.md). A successful kernel log alone is not proof of higher throughput. BF16/TF32 are not added to Turing. This is not a claim of a 2× application/game speedup.

## Start here

1. [Safety and scope](docs/SAFETY.md)
2. [Agent engineering guide](docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md): investigation, porting, failure lessons
3. [2080 Ti reproduction](docs/TURING.md): inputs, build, one-shot boot, verification, recovery
4. [3090 experience](docs/AMPERE.md): upstream and known-working revision
5. [Licensing/provenance](NOTICE.md)

### Offline entry points

```sh
# Linux, Python 3.10+, C compiler; no GPU or sudo needed
make test
# Protocol simulation with privately supplied firmware; no GPU access
make test-private ASSETS=/absolute/path/to/verified/assets
# Compile only against matching installed kernel headers
make module
```

`make module` builds a **hardware-execution-disabled** module by default. A reviewed exact-profile experiment can opt into compilation with `make module ENABLE_EXPERIMENT=1`; runtime parameters are still required. No target installs/loads modules, edits boot configuration, flashes anything, or runs external installers.

```sh
python3 tools/inventory.py --bdf 0000:42:00.0 --output local/inventory.json
python3 tools/rom_analyze.py local/card-prom.bin --extract local/native-fwsec.bin
python3 tools/check_assets.py --assets local/assets
```

Inventory uses OS metadata and `nvidia-smi`, not BAR mmap or resets. Output is private and gitignored. ROM analysis is file-only; obtaining a full dump is a separate hardware operation covered in the guide.

## Tested boundary

- One Leadtek TU102 rev a1: `10de:1e04 / 107d:1e04`, VBIOS `90.02.33.00.3F`, VRAM-modded to 22 GiB, 68 SMs; kernel 6.8.0-147 and NVIDIA open 595.99.02. Second same-model card was the locked control, **not a second validated unlock**.
- GIGABYTE MZ32-AR0 / AMD server, separate ASPEED display, Secure Boot disabled. Shared IOMMU group observed: no bus-wide resets.
- Turing: **one-shot only**, no module unload path, mandatory fail-closed initramfs gate. Do not make it the permanent default.
- Ampere: external [Zagitta/gpu-unlock](https://github.com/Zagitta/gpu-unlock); not vendored here.
- Other boards, 11 GiB variants, Windows, Ada and Blackwell: **not validated here**.

Public source derives from the tested source with a default-off compile gate and publication packaging changes. It is not byte-identical to the historical test binary. No public-source hardware rerun is claimed.

## Attribution

Based on [haohervchb/Turing-unlock](https://github.com/haohervchb/Turing-unlock), [xrip/cmp50hx-unlock](https://github.com/xrip/cmp50hx-unlock), CMP40HX work, Jon Pry's V67 research, and NVIDIA driver interfaces. We do not claim discovery of the exploit. See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

items.readme:
# 捡手机 · FoundPhone Studio

《捡手机》是一个可以通过 AI 添加剧情的交互式虚拟手机框架。你不需要重新制作手机界面，只需要准备人物设定、聊天记录和剧情要求，让 AI 填入故事数据。

默认打开完整 App 测试预览：49 个 App 已安装，内页只有中性的测试文字，不含剧情或真实账号。桌面底部为四个 App。`/?preview=test` 也可进入相同测试版本；纯空白入口为 `/?template=blank`。

## 可以做什么

- 使用现成的锁屏、桌面、App Store、通知、控制中心和手机 App 页面。
- 长按桌面调整图标、文件夹和小组件；在手机 App Store 中选择安装 App。
- 添加微信、KakaoTalk 聊天，以及 Instagram、X 等社交内容。
- 添加联系人、照片、备忘录、通知、模拟来电、密码、互动选项和多个结局。
- 通过事件连接不同 App，并在浏览器中保存玩家进度。
- 生成静态网站，分享给朋友；首次加载并完成缓存后，核心剧情可离线运行。

App 库目前有 49 个注册入口。各 App 的页面覆盖不同，并非真实服务客户端，也不代表所有功能或界面均已完整还原。

## 零基础使用

1. 登录 [GitHub](https://github.com/)。
2. 打开本项目仓库，点击右上角 **Fork**，复制到自己的账号。若已启用模板，也可以选择 **Use this template**。
3. 用支持读取和修改项目的 AI 编程工具打开自己的副本，例如 Codex、WorkBuddy 或 Claude Code。
4. 复制下面的提示词，把故事发给 AI。让它先阅读 `AGENTS.md`，优先修改 `stories/template/story.json`。
5. 请 AI 启动预览，亲自测试聊天、密码、电话和每个结局。
6. 按[部署教程](docs/GITHUB_PAGES.md)发布网页。
7. 把生成的网址分享给朋友。

### 复制给 AI

> 我想基于《捡手机》制作自己的互动手机故事。请先指导我 Fork 原仓库，在我的 Fork 中阅读 AGENTS.md 和剧情脚本规范，然后根据下面的故事内容自动生成角色、聊天、App 数据、时间线和剧情事件，运行校验并修复错误。尽量只修改故事数据，不要重写手机 UI。我的故事是：【填写故事】。

也可以提供图片、聊天记录和具体触发要求。请只使用你有权公开的素材，不要提交真实账号密码或私人聊天。

## 本地预览

先安装 Node.js 22，然后在项目目录执行：

```sh
npm ci
npm run story:validate
npm run story:test
npm run story:preview
```

打开终端显示的本地网址。正式构建：

```sh
npm run build
npm run preview
```

上传 `dist/` 的内容即可部署。不能直接双击 HTML 文件运行。

默认故事位于 `stories/template/story.json`；纯空白手机位于 `stories/blank/story.json`，可用 `/?template=blank` 查看。你可以替换演示数据，也可以通过环境变量 `STORY_FILE` 选择其他作品。故事数据与界面代码分离，作品运行时不需要 AI 在线。

## 演示与截图

[在线体验](https://keoyyo85.github.io/FoundPhone-Studio/) · [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/keoyyo85/FoundPhone-Studio)

| 桌面 | 设置 | 聊天 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![桌面](docs/images/home.png) | ![设置](docs/images/settings.png) | ![聊天](docs/images/chat.png) |

## 常见问题

**不会写代码怎么办？** 把上面的提示词和故事发给能够修改项目文件的 AI。普通聊天工具若无法访问文件，需要你手动保存它生成的脚本。

**为什么没有全部 App？** 新手机只安装少量 App。打开手机里的 App Store 获取其他 App；作者也可以在脚本的 `installedApps` 中配置。

**为什么修改后还看到旧进度？** 玩家存档与故事分开保存。剧情有较大变化时，让 AI 增加脚本的 `revision`，再重新构建。

**数据保存在哪里？** 玩家进度保存在当前浏览器。换浏览器、清理网站数据可能导致进度丢失；源码 ZIP 不包含浏览器存档。

**能直接填写自然语言吗？** 自然语言由创作阶段的 AI 转成 JSON。框架本身不在运行时调用模型，也不会自动执行脚本中的 HTML 或 JavaScript。

**Fork 后如何上线？** 见[GitHub Pages 教程](docs/GITHUB_PAGES.md)。首次需要在自己仓库中启用 Actions 和 Pages。

## 开发与许可

[AI 创作指南](docs/AI_STORY_GUIDE.md) · [脚本规范](docs/STORY_SCHEMA.md) · [架构](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)

验证命令：`npm run typecheck`、`npm run lint`、`npm test`、`npm run story:validate`、`npm run story:test`、`npm run build`。浏览器回归使用 `npm run test:e2e`。

项目许可见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。故事与素材的权利由其作者确认。安装、启动和构建不会自动 Fork、Star 或推送仓库。

items.name: english-rs
items.description: English, rewritten in Rust: grammar as trait bounds, pronouns as borrows, and englishc, a compiler with rustc-style diagnostics for prose
items.readme: English (C edition) has been in production since about the fifth century. It has no type checker, so "he don't" ships. Its pronouns are raw pointers that can dangle or point at two things at once. Its plurals and past tenses are a hand-maintained table of legacy special cases that every user has to memorise. This repository is the rewrite, and it comes in two parts. The **`english`** crate is English (Rust edition). You write sentences as Rust tokens, and grammar is enforced by the type system: subject-verb agreement is a trait bound, case is a trait, determiners know which numbers and sounds they may precede, and a pronoun is a borrow of its antecedent, so the borrow checker rejects a dangling "it". **`englishc`** is the migration tool for the fifteen centuries of legacy English already out there. It reads ordinary prose and reports what the new edition would reject, in rustc's diagnostic format, with `--fix` for the cases where the right answer is unambiguous. ## englishc ```console $ cargo run -p englishc -- examples/essay.txt Compiling examples/essay.txt (english 2026) ... error[E0001]: mismatched verb form --> examples/essay.txt:3:70 | 3 | Irregardless of the weather, me and my brother goed to the beach. He are | -- ^^^ expected `is`, found `are` | | | `He` is third-person singular | = note: in English (Rust edition) this is a compile error: the trait bound `He: TakesAre` is not satisfied help: use `is` | 3 - Irregardless of the weather, me and my brother goed to the beach. He are 3 + Irregardless of the weather, me and my brother goed to the beach. He is | ... error: could not compile `examples/essay.txt` due to 11 previous errors; 5 warnings emitted (run `englishc --fix examples/essay.txt` to apply 15 suggestions) ``` `englishc --fix` applies every machine-applicable suggestion, as `cargo fix` does, and repeats until nothing changes. On the sample essay it produces correct prose and leaves one warning, an ambiguous "it", because only the author knows whether they meant the dog or the ball. Other flags work the way rustc's do. `englishc --explain E0005` prints the long explanation of an error code, `englishc -W help` lists every lint, `-A lint` and `-D lint` allow or deny one, `--error-format short` prints one line per diagnostic, and a file name of `-` (or none) reads standard input. Inside a document, a line reading `#![allow(double_negative)]` allows a lint for the whole file, and `#[allow(E0002)]` allows it for the next line only, which is how you ship "I can't get no satisfaction" on purpose. | code | lint | catches | |---------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------| | E0001 | `subject_verb_agreement` | he are, they was, she don't, he always go | | E0002 | `indefinite_article` | a apple, an unicorn, a hour, a MBA | | E0003 | `of_for_have` | could of, should of | | E0004 | `regularized_verb` | goed, runned, bringed | | E0005 | `wrong_verb_form` | had went, have ate, I seen it | | E0006 | `regularized_plural` | childs, mouses, criterions, childrens | | E0007 | `its_confusion` | its a trap, it's own | | E0008 | `your_confusion` | your welcome, your a genius | | E0009 | `there_confusion` | their is, there going, their going to | | E0010 | `then_for_than` | bigger then, rather then | | E0011 | `unknown_word` | irregardless, alot, dont | | E0012 | `lowercase_i` | i think | | E0013 | `objective_case_subject` | me and my brother went (fix: my brother and I went) | | warning | `ambiguous_pronoun` | the dog chased the ball until it stopped | | warning | `double_negative` | I don't have no money | | warning | `repeated_word` | the the | | warning | `absolute_adjective` | very unique (`unique` is a `bool`, not `PartialOrd`) | | warning | `unused_literally` | literally (prefix with `_` if intentional) | | warning | `non_capitalized_sentences`| a sentence that starts in lower case | The lints are deliberately conservative. Each rule looks at a word and its neighbours and fires only where the neighbour rules out the correct reading, so "its a" is flagged and "its tail" is not. Mistakes in irregular forms are predicted rather than listed: for every irregular verb the lint works out what a learner's `-ed` would produce, for every irregular noun what `-s` would produce, and it flags exactly those spellings, minus the handful that are real words ("seed", "winded", "putted"). To keep that honest, the compiler is run over the prose of *The Rust Programming Language*, about 150,000 words that a team of editors has already been over. It reports no errors and 17 warnings. A dozen of those are ambiguous pronouns, several of them genuinely ambiguous ("The runtime will pause the future until it is ready"), and one is a true positive: the book calls ownership "Rust's most unique feature". ## The english crate ```rust use english::english; let text = english!(The dog barks. I 'm happy! These mice are small. She doesn 't care.); assert_eq!(text.to_string(), "The dog barks. I'm happy! These mice are small. She doesn't care."); ``` A sentence that type-checks is rendered back into ordinary text. One that doesn't is a compile error, with a message that says why: ```console error[E0277]: subject-verb disagreement: `He` needs the -s form of this verb --> src/main.rs:7:13 | 7 | let _ = english!(He don 't care); | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ | | | third-person singular subjects take -s | required by a bound introduced by this call | = help: the trait `TakesBase` is not implemented for `He` = note: he runs, she does, it has, the dog barks ``` The same mechanism rejects `english!(I is happy)` ("`I` cannot take `is`"), `english!(Me am happy)` ("`Me` cannot be the subject of a sentence"), `english!(A dogs barks)` ("`A` cannot come before a plural noun") and `english!(A apple is red)` ("`A` cannot come before a vowel sound; write `An`"). Each of these is a `compile_fail` doctest, so the claims in this paragraph are checked by `cargo test`. Contractions are written with a space, as in `don 't`, because since Rust 2021 `don't` is a reserved prefix and rustc will tell you to insert one. Inside the macro, `'t`, `'s`, `'re`, `'m`, `'ve`, `'ll` and `'d` are lifetimes that attach to the word before them when the sentence is rendered. ### Pronouns are borrows A `Pronoun<'a, P>` holds a shared borrow of the noun it stands for. It cannot outlive that noun, and the noun cannot be moved out of the story while the pronoun is in use: ```console error[E0505]: cannot move out of `dog` because it is borrowed --> src/main.rs:6:10 | 4 | let dog = Noun::new("dog").the(); | --- binding `dog` declared here 5 | let it = dog.pronoun(); // `it` borrows the dog | --- borrow of `dog` occurs here 6 | drop(dog); // the dog leaves the story | ^^^ move out of `dog` occurs here 7 | println!("{}", english!(it barks)); | ------------------ borrow later used here | help: consider cloning the value if the performance cost is acceptable | 5 | let it = dog.clone().pronoun(); // `it` borrows the dog | ++++++++ ``` An ambiguous pronoun cannot be written at all, because a pronoun borrows exactly one noun. A `Person` has their pronouns in their type, and since a name does not tell you someone's pronouns, `Person::new("Ada")` defaults to `They` until you call `.pronouns(She)` or similar. ### Inflection is computed, never written Outside the macro you write dictionary forms and the crate inflects them, so overregularised forms are unrepresentable: ```rust use english::prelude::*; assert_eq!(She.verb("go").then("home").to_string(), "She goes home."); assert_eq!(They.past("go").then("home").to_string(), "They went home."); assert_eq!(It.perfect("begin").to_string(), "It has begun."); assert_eq!(Noun::new("mouse").plural().the().to_string(), "the mice"); assert_eq!(Noun::new("hour").a().to_string(), "an hour"); ``` ### How the macro works `english!` splits its input into sentences at `.`, `!` and `?`. In each one it finds the subject, which is a pronoun, a demonstrative, a determiner followed by one noun, or a variable holding a `Noun`, `Person` or `Pronoun`. The verb's spelling goes to a `const fn` that classifies it as a base form, an `-s` form, `am`, `is`, `are`, `was`, `were`, or an unmarked past or modal. That class becomes a type through a const generic, and `Verb::::agrees_with` and its siblings each require a different `Takes*` bound of the subject. The noun after a determiner is typed the same way, with `const fn is_plural` and `const fn wants_an` choosing `Noun` or `Noun` and `Sound` or `Sound`. Every trait carries a `#[diagnostic::on_unimplemented]` message, so a failed bound reads like a grammar note rather than a trait-solver dump. All of this runs on stable Rust. The tables behind it live in `english::lexicon`: 178 irregular verbs, 68 irregular nouns, and the rules for silent h, "y"-sound vowels, initialisms and numbers that decide between `a` and `an`. `englishc` uses the same tables, which is why the compiler and the crate agree. The macro understands a subset of English on purpose. Each sentence is one subject, one finite verb and anything at all after it; everything after the verb is passed through unchecked, which is also how English (C edition) handles it. ## Playground `playground/` holds a single-page playground that runs `englishc` in the browser. `python3 -I playground/build.py` compiles the compiler to `wasm32-unknown-unknown` (it exposes a small C ABI, so no bindgen is needed), compiles each program in `playground/examples/` with rustc and records its real output, and writes the result to `playground/dist/`. ## Building and testing ```console cargo test # unit tests, doctests, and the compile_fail examples cargo run -p englishc -- -W help python3 -I playground/build.py # needs the wasm32-unknown-unknown target ``` The workspace has no dependencies beyond the standard library.

items.description: dsh-go — DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：手机本机运行，也能遥控你的电脑。Android · Unofficial.
items.readme:
简体中文 · English

DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端。手机上直接跑，也能遥控你电脑上的 DSH。


Deepy 和鲸娘，陪你干活

干活时敲代码，做完来个空翻，等你确认会举手。打开「App 外显示」，它们还会跟你到桌面。


进群领内测包

内测包在群里发，QQ 群为主。下周公测，届时主代码仓库转为公开。

  

QQ 群号 1132118290，电脑上可直接点此加群。微信群二维码每周更新，过期请加 QQ 群。
装过早期测试版的，请先卸载再安装：正式版换了签名。


本机运行，也能遥控电脑

内置 Linux 环境，免 Root、免 Termux。电脑上的 DSH，也能一键切过去接着用。


插话、打断，过程自动收好

回复中途也能插话，排队的消息随时「立即发送」。做完的过程折叠成一行。


原生界面，也有网页版

和官方网页版一键切换，停在同一段对话，下次打开还是你上次用的那个。


分享卡、对话回放和链接

回复一键做成分享卡。整段对话生成链接，对方在浏览器里回放，链接端到端加密。


横屏与平板

横屏手机和平板重新排版：侧栏常驻，内容居中，弹出键盘也不挤。


主题配色与桌面图标

六套主题色，也能跟随壁纸或自选颜色。四款桌面图标，三种功能图标风格。


中文，也说 English

全部界面支持英文，在设置里切换，默认跟随系统。


手机操控

看屏幕、帮你点，三档确认随你选。付款、密码和验证码，永远交还给你。


## 常见问题
和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？
没有关系。dsh-go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身，模型在 DeepSeek 云端，需要联网，按你的账户计费。
安全吗？
本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容。手机操控遇到付款、密码、验证码和系统设置，一律交还给你。
切到后台会被杀吗？
部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。dsh-go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。
对手机有什么要求？
Android 8 及以上，arm64。首次打开会准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间。
开源吗？
会。下周公测时主代码仓库转为公开，代码以 AGPL-3.0 开源。dsh-go 的名称和标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘两位吉祥物，保留所有权利。
